dashboard_cards_layout_check.name: dashboard_cards_layout_check
dashboard_cards_layout_check.value: "dashboard_cards"."x" >= 0 and "dashboard_cards"."y" >= 0 and "dashboard_cards"."width" between 1 and 12 and "dashboard_cards"."height" between 1 and 12 and "dashboard_cards"."x" + "dashboard_cards"."width" <= 12

measurement_results_correction_reason_ch.name: measurement_results_correction_reason_check
measurement_results_correction_reason_ch.value: ("measurement_results"."supersedes_result_id" is null and "measurement_results"."correction_reason" is null) or ("measurement_results"."supersedes_result_id" is not null and length(trim("measurement_results"."correction_reason")) > 0)

oidc_identities_issuer_subject_length_ch.name: oidc_identities_issuer_subject_length_check
oidc_identities_issuer_subject_length_ch.value: length("oidc_identities"."issuer") between 1 and 2048 and length("oidc_identities"."subject") between 1 and 255

record_review_threads_resolution_check.name: record_review_threads_resolution_check
record_review_threads_resolution_check.value:
("record_review_threads"."status" = 'open' and "record_review_threads"."resolved_at" is null and "record_review_threads"."resolved_by" is null)
          or ("record_review_threads"."status" = 'resolved' and "record_review_threads"."resolved_at" is not null and "record_review_threads"."resolved_by" is not null)

specification_evaluations_missing_value_.name: specification_evaluations_missing_value_check
specification_evaluations_missing_value_.value: ("specification_evaluations"."status" = 'missing' and "specification_evaluations"."measurement_result_id" is null and "specification_evaluations"."evaluated_canonical_value" is null) or ("specification_evaluations"."status" <> 'missing' and "specification_evaluations"."measurement_result_id" is not null and "specification_evaluations"."evaluated_canonical_value" is not null)

specification_revisions_hard_limit_check.name: specification_revisions_hard_limit_check
specification_revisions_hard_limit_check.value: "specification_revisions"."lower_limit" is not null or "specification_revisions"."upper_limit" is not null

specification_revisions_hard_order_check.name: specification_revisions_hard_order_check
specification_revisions_hard_order_check.value: "specification_revisions"."lower_limit" is null or "specification_revisions"."upper_limit" is null or "specification_revisions"."lower_limit" <= "specification_revisions"."upper_limit"
